# Learn-then-Test: sensitivity to the threshold grid (generated by scripts/m4_grid_sensitivity.py)

Same frozen scores, splits and delta = 0.05 as results/m4_guarantees.csv; only the grid of Train keep fractions changes. Kept = fraction of Test shots kept. 'Both select' = experiments where Learn-then-Test certifies and the plug-in rule selects; price = plug-in kept minus Learn-then-Test kept on those, in percentage points. Exceeds / significant: over certified experiments (significant = one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound on Test error above alpha).
